mainEntity.name: Can Answer Engine Optimization help my small business in specific cities like New York City or Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AEO is highly effective for small businesses operating in specific geographic areas like New York City or Los Angeles. It helps ensure that when users ask AI engines or voice assistants for local services – such as 'best pizza near Times Square' or 'accountant in downtown LA' – your business is presented as a relevant and authoritative answer. By optimizing for local intent and ensuring accurate location data, AEO enhances your visibility among customers seeking services in your service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO significantly helps small businesses in specific cities like New York City or Los Angeles by optimizing for local search queries and ensuring accurate location data for AI-powered results.
